description: Land Acquisition - Malgala and Beliattawila, Padukka D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It provides descriptions of multiple land lots, their extents, locations, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
